prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a low-speed head-on collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1076; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Front bumper cover cracked across the center with the left headlamp assembly broken and the hood leading edge bent. The radiator support shows deformation that may or may not stem from this collision, so the question of whether all listed damage belongs to this impact remains open and will be checked during teardown. Repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, headlamp, and hood, with straightening of the radiator support. The invoices show no repeated charges, and the labor hours fit the extent of the damage. No prior damage to this vehicle is known to me.
